decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposed alterations and additions to the house, comprising erection of a single storey side extension with alterations to ground floor windows and doors, alterations to create of a first floor bathroom, raising the internal floor to games and utility rooms, reinstating fireplaces to the breakfast room, creation of a raised patio area to the side of the house, and alterations to internal doors, entrance gate and door to street, as shown on drawings Existing Floor Plan, Existing Plans - Ground Floor, Existing Plans - Fist Floor, Existing Plans - Second Floor, Proposed Alterations - Drawing No. 2, Proposed Roof Plan and Proposed Section; all received 13 October 2009, are satisfactory and would not result in harm to the special architectural or historic interest of the building, nor the appearance and character of the conservation area or living conditions of neighbours. The proposal is considered consistent with policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development), and H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations) of the adopted Unitary Development Plan.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 5 - No development shall take place until samples of the materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the hereby permitted have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details

Condition : 6 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the flank wall of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
description: Erection of a single storey side extension with alterations to ground floor windows & doors, alterations to create of a first floor bathroom, raise internal floor to games and utility rooms, reinstate fireplaces to breakfast room, create raised patio area to side of house, alterations to internal door and alteration of entrance gate and door to street.
